text:
rita: heads-up: starting staged rollout for v3.3.0 in 3m (change window 21:00-22:00 UTC). Canary = 5% in eu-central. Preflight green but want ops on watch for first tail signals.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary allocation created (5%).

ben: metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/176313 p95 +22% vs baseline, a few big outliers at t+2m. No 5xx spike yet.

devops: seeing repeated kvcache evictions on canary nodes, evict_rate ~2.8x at 21:02. Memory steady.
sre-oncall: confirmed. Eviction churn corresponds with requests >3000 tokens.

rita: thanks. Options: 1) hold at 5% and pin canary to previous quant variant (v3.2.5-quant), 2) rollback canary to last GA (v3.2.5), 3) proceed and monitor. I'm leaning to pause the percent increase and pin. Thoughts?

ben: hold + pin. We should avoid widening until we know if kvcache behavior is the issue.

release-manager: agree with hold. Add a line to release notes about a temporary pin if we take that route. Also reminder to update change-log for the change window.

devops: I can execute the pin. @deploy-bot please suspend automatic percent increases and mark the allocation sticky while I flip it.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: halting further percent increases per request.

devops: pinning canary allocation canary-eu-central-1 -> v3.2.5-quant now...

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.2.5-quant. Traffic increase suspended. Audit: deploy-audit/1763131313-pin.

sre-oncall: monitoring: p95 trending down after pin, eviction rate falling toward baseline. Posting short log sample from spike: ```
[21:02:11] kvcache: evict key=session-9187 shard=5 reason=mem_pressure
[21:02:11] model: req=id=9f3b seq_len=3784 latency=542ms
[21:02:12] kvcache: miss key=session-9187
```

rita: great. Please keep this pinned until we have an ML/infra triage. I'll update release notes: "eu-central canary temporarily pinned to v3.2.5-quant due to KV cache eviction-related latency observed on v3.3.0 canary." Anyone object?

ben: no objections. Also add a note to rollback playbook about how to unpin if we need to revert to v3.2.5 full or v3.2.5-quant.

release-manager: done: RN updated and changelog flagged. Ticket created: INVEST-3124 for deeper root-cause analysis.

rita: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene here in 10m to decide slow bump vs keep pinned. If latency resurges we'll escalate to immediate rollback. :white_check_mark:
